ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Somali Community
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota's Somali community and track the flow of money to identify any potential corruption or wrongdoing.
questions: Who is behind the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and identify those responsible. I recommend starting with the Minnesota Somali community and tracking the flow of money to identify any potential corruption or wrongdoing.
